<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:versionCode="315"
    android:versionName="12.2"
    android:compileSdkVersion="37"
    android:compileSdkVersionCodename="17"
    package="com.limelight.cloudsync"
    platformBuildVersionCode="37"
    platformBuildVersionName="17">
    <uses-sdk
        android:minSdkVersion="21"
        android:targetSdkVersion="36"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.VIBRATE"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAPTURE_KEYBOARD"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="com.android.providers.tv.permission.READ_EPG_DATA"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="com.android.providers.tv.permission.WRITE_EPG_DATA"/>
    <uses-permission
        android:name="android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE"
        android:maxSdkVersion="33"/>
    <uses-feature
        android:name="android.hardware.touchscreen"
        android:required="false"/>
    <uses-feature
        android:name="android.hardware.wifi"
        android:required="false"/>
    <uses-feature
        android:name="android.hardware.gamepad"
        android:required="false"/>
    <uses-feature
        android:name="android.hardware.usb.host"
        android:required="false"/>
    <uses-feature
        android:name="android.software.leanback"
        android:required="false"/>
    <uses-feature
        android:name="android.hardware.sensor.accelerometer"
        android:required="false"/>
    <uses-feature
        android:name="android.hardware.sensor.gyroscope"
        android:required="false"/>
    <uses-feature
        android:name="android.hardware.type.pc"
        android:required="false"/>
    <application
        android:theme="@style/AppTheme"
        android:label="@string/app_label"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher"
        android:debuggable="true"
        android:allowBackup="true"
        android:installLocation="auto"
        android:banner="@drawable/atv_banner"
        android:isGame="true"
        android:extractNativeLibs="true"
        android:fullBackupContent="@xml/backup_rules"
        android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"
        android:appCategory="game"
        android:gwpAsanMode="always"
        android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/backup_rules_s"
        android:localeConfig="@xml/locales_config"
        android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="false">
        <provider
            android:name="com.limelight.PosterContentProvider"
            android:enabled="true"
            android:exported="true"
            android:authorities="poster.com.limelight.cloudsync"/>
        <uses-library
            android:name="com.sec.android.app.multiwindow"
            android:required="false"/>
        <meta-data
            android:name="com.sec.android.support.multiwindow"
            android:value="true"/>
        <meta-data
            android:name="com.android.graphics.intervention.wm.allowDownscale"
            android:value="false"/>
        <meta-data
            android:name="android.game_mode_config"
            android:resource="@xml/game_mode_config"/>
        <activity
            android:name="com.limelight.PcView"
            android:exported="true"
            android:configChanges="fontScale|layoutDirection|smallestScreenSize|screenSize|uiMode|screenLayout|orientation|navigation|keyboardHidden|keyboard|touchscreen|mnc|mcc"
            android:resizeableActivity="true"
            android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="true">
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowSize"
                android:value="system-default"/>
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowOrientation"
                android:value="landscape"/>
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN"/>
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LEANBACK_LAUNCHER"/>
                <category android:name="tv.ouya.intent.category.APP"/>
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>
        <activity
            android:theme="@android:style/Theme.Material.NoActionBar"
            android:label="@string/app_label"
            android:name="com.limelight.cloudsync.CloudSyncActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait"
            android:configChanges="smallestScreenSize|screenSize|uiMode|screenLayout|orientation|keyboardHidden"
            android:resizeableActivity="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN"/>
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"/>
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.MULTIWINDOW_LAUNCHER"/>
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>
        <activity
            android:name="com.limelight.ShortcutTrampoline"
            android:exported="true"
            android:configChanges="fontScale|layoutDirection|smallestScreenSize|screenSize|uiMode|screenLayout|orientation|navigation|keyboardHidden|keyboard|touchscreen|locale|mnc|mcc"
            android:noHistory="true"
            android:resizeableActivity="true"
            android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="true">
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowSize"
                android:value="system-default"/>
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowOrientation"
                android:value="landscape"/>
        </activity>
        <activity
            android:name="com.limelight.AppView"
            android:configChanges="fontScale|layoutDirection|smallestScreenSize|screenSize|uiMode|screenLayout|orientation|navigation|keyboardHidden|keyboard|touchscreen|mnc|mcc"
            android:resizeableActivity="true"
            android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="true">
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowSize"
                android:value="system-default"/>
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowOrientation"
                android:value="landscape"/>
        </activity>
        <activity
            android:label="Streaming Settings"
            android:name="com.limelight.preferences.StreamSettings"
            android:configChanges="fontScale|layoutDirection|smallestScreenSize|screenSize|uiMode|screenLayout|orientation|navigation|keyboardHidden|keyboard|touchscreen|mnc|mcc"
            android:resizeableActivity="true"
            android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="true">
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowSize"
                android:value="system-default"/>
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowOrientation"
                android:value="landscape"/>
        </activity>
        <activity
            android:label="Add Computer Manually"
            android:name="com.limelight.preferences.AddComputerManually"
            android:configChanges="fontScale|layoutDirection|smallestScreenSize|screenSize|uiMode|screenLayout|orientation|navigation|keyboardHidden|keyboard|touchscreen|mnc|mcc"
            android:windowSoftInputMode="stateVisible"
            android:resizeableActivity="true"
            android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="true">
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowSize"
                android:value="system-default"/>
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowOrientation"
                android:value="landscape"/>
        </activity>
        <activity
            android:theme="@style/StreamTheme"
            android:name="com.limelight.Game"
            android:excludeFromRecents="true"
            android:launchMode="singleTask"
            android:configChanges="fontScale|layoutDirection|smallestScreenSize|screenSize|uiMode|screenLayout|orientation|navigation|keyboardHidden|keyboard|touchscreen|locale|mnc|mcc"
            android:noHistory="true"
            android:resizeableActivity="true"
            android:supportsPictureInPicture="true"
            android:preferMinimalPostProcessing="true"
            android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="false">
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowSize"
                android:value="system-default"/>
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowOrientation"
                android:value="landscape"/>
            <meta-data
                android:name="com.nvidia.immediateInput"
                android:value="true"/>
            <meta-data
                android:name="com.nvidia.rawCursorInput"
                android:value="true"/>
        </activity>
        <service
            android:label="mDNS PC Auto-Discovery Service"
            android:name="com.limelight.discovery.DiscoveryService"/>
        <service
            android:label="Computer Management Service"
            android:name="com.limelight.computers.ComputerManagerService"/>
        <service
            android:label="Usb Driver Service"
            android:name="com.limelight.binding.input.driver.UsbDriverService"/>
        <activity
            android:name="com.limelight.HelpActivity"
            android:configChanges="fontScale|layoutDirection|smallestScreenSize|screenSize|uiMode|screenLayout|orientation|navigation|keyboardHidden|keyboard|touchscreen|mnc|mcc"
            android:resizeableActivity="true"
            android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="true">
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowSize"
                android:value="system-default"/>
            <meta-data
                android:name="WindowManagerPreference:FreeformWindowOrientation"
                android:value="landscape"/>
        </activity>
        <provider
            android:name="androidx.startup.InitializationProvider"
            android:exported="false"
            android:authorities="com.limelight.cloudsync.androidx-startup">
            <meta-data
                android:name="okhttp3.internal.platform.PlatformInitializer"
                android:value="androidx.startup"/>
        </provider>
    </application>
</manifest>

limitations: Static decompiler observations do not establish runtime behavior; the APK is never executed.
Method signatures use provider display types; DEX prototypes come from frozen JADX metadata. Display names may be aliases, and overload indices are local to this engine and artifact.
Class inventories use parsed metadata before code generation, including synthetic members that may be omitted from decompiled source. Source positions remain unknown.

Incoming reference totals count JADX using nodes. Direct invoke entries within a using method report raw DEX code-unit offsets and method indexes, but coverage is limited to those nodes and directly matched invokes; it does not establish every possible dynamic or reflective call site.

Manifest summary fields are extracted by the upstream engine; decoded XML is retained for verification. APK signatures, split APKs, native libraries and Android runtime capture are not verified by this provider.
